key_rationale: With headline CPI at 5.02% and core inflation moderating to 4.50%, the real policy rate is now firmly in positive territory, which is sufficient to anchor inflation expectations. Given the robust GVA growth of 7.60% and the risks of excessive real interest rates stifling the recovery, I believe the stance should shift to neutral to avoid an over-tightening bias that could unnecessarily dampen economic momentum.
